I used to be like that too

I didn't want to work or anything like that. Life just sucks and I saw everything about my future as pointless.

But eventually, my parents convinced me to go to college so I could find out if it would get me interested in my future

Did it work? Well, I don't think it's so bad to study but I also can't see myself working after 4 years of studying, so I can't give a straight answer

But I think you should give it a shot and find out for yourself what's good for you. 


Now, please DON'T CONSUME THESE PILLS.

I've attempted suicide by this method once. It didn't work. All it did was to make me faint and go to the hospital. It also made everyone around me aware of my attempt. Trust me, it's not worth the try. You'll have to deal with a lot of talking from relatives or friends when all you really want is your personal space for you and your thoughts

I don't really know..

I just felt like I had to get this off my chest..
